summary: Vault 158 recovery remains held after its authorized configuration readback. ckSOL PR #610 remains draft with the reserve off. A rent-only/dust balance could expose the SOL address before processing funds were ready; the preflight now requires either a minimum deposit already present or processing funds ready, with a focused regression test. Callback safety still relies on stop-and-drain; other deploy paths are not enforced. Stability Pool and vault 51 work continue under Bram.
plainSummary: Vault 158 recovery remains held. ckSOL stays in draft review with its reserve off; a fix now hides the SOL address for rent-only or dust balances until processing is ready. Stop-and-drain remains the callback mitigation.
